instructions: Put a large pot of water on to boil for the noodles.
Slice the beef thinly against the grain, about 1/8 inch thick. In a bowl, toss it with the oyster sauce, 4 minced garlic cloves and the pepper. Leave it while you prep everything else.
Whisk together the juice of the 2 limes (that should be about 1/4 cup), 1/3 cup warm water, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar and 2 minced garlic cloves until the sugar dissolves. Set it aside.
Cook the vermicelli in the boiling water according to the package, usually 3 to 5 minutes. Drain it, rinse under cold water and drain again.

Meanwhile, cut the carrot and cucumber into thin matchsticks, tear the lettuce and pick the cilantro and mint leaves. Divide the noodles, lettuce, bean sprouts, carrot, cucumber and herbs among 4 bowls.

Trim the lemongrass and mince only the pale white part. Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium heat. Add half of the lemongrass and stir for 30 to 40 seconds, until it smells fragrant and shrinks down.

Turn the heat to medium-high. Add half of the beef in a single layer and leave it alone for 20 to 30 seconds. Add 1 tbsp fish sauce and stir-fry for about 1 minute, until the beef is just cooked and no longer red. Transfer it to a plate.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil and the rest of the lemongrass, then cook the second half of the beef with the remaining 1 tbsp fish sauce the same way.
Top each bowl with beef, then fried shallots and peanuts. Spoon over the dressing, starting with about 3 tbsp per bowl, and serve the rest on the side.
method_notes: Cup of Yum is the lead (4.7 from 30, 30 minutes): thin beef marinated in oyster sauce, pepper and garlic, lemongrass fried first, the beef cooked in small batches over high heat, then served on vermicelli with a lime fish sauce dressing, fried shallots and peanuts. Take Two Eggs adds soy sauce, brown sugar and onion to the marinade and Summer & Spice uses a bigger dressing; both confirm the layout. Amounts are scaled from Cup of Yum's 1 lb for 2 to 3 people up to 1 1/2 lb for 4. The marinade is 15 minutes while the noodles and vegetables are prepped, and the base is mild with no chili.
